_emulation_only_rationale: Declares NO export_lane and is not shippable. It exists so the continuous trellis rate surface can be ALLOCATED against a capability gate that actually fires. The generic `research` profile declares no target_platform, and trellis_allocator._capability_gate returns legal for every family when the platform is None -- a gate that cannot compare anything is provenance, not a gate (principle 9). Naming sm_121 here makes the E2M1 SM120+ and E4M3 SM89+ floors real comparisons against the GB10 the anchors were measured on.
description: RESEARCH-ONLY allocation profile for the rate-256 tail-biting trellis families on GB10 (Blackwell sm_121). It admits the closed TCQ_E2M1/TCQ_E4M3 rate vocabulary plus the scalar terminals an honest mixed menu needs, so a DP can rank a continuous trellis rung against NVFP4/FP8/BF16 in one currency. It makes NO serving claim: no pinned runtime publishes an executed-activation-contract table for these families, so every lane here resolves route_status `unattested` and export fails closed. A trellis rung selected under this profile is a REPORT about where the allocator would spend bytes, not an artifact. (The families were the retired Gridbook lane's; that lane was removed 2026-09-02 and the Tessera wire is their successor.)
_no_format_rules_rationale: Deliberately declares NO format_rules, so check_serving_format admits everything -- exactly like the generic `research` profile it exists beside. Naming the 2546 addressable TCQ rungs in an allow list would assert they are format_registry entries, and they are not: a trellis rung has no RTN quantize_dequantize and no FormatSpec, because nothing renders one. Registering 2546 stubs to satisfy a menu bound would put unrenderable names in front of every menu-construction path in the tree to buy a bound the manifest already supplies. The menu here is bounded by PRISMAQUANT_TRELLIS_SURFACE's measured anchors on the trellis side and by FORMATS + check_format_applicability on the scalar side; what this profile adds is the one thing neither of those can -- an exact target_platform, so trellis_allocator._capability_gate compares SM121 against the E2M1 SM120+ / E4M3 SM89+ floors instead of returning legal without comparing anything.
_no_runtime_rationale: Declares NO runtime on purpose. It named `gridbook_plugin` until 2026-09-02, when the Gridbook codebook serving lane was retired (archive/gridbook_lane_2026-09-02/). This profile never made a serving claim -- it is emulation_only with no export_lane -- so losing the runtime name costs it nothing: what it exists for is the exact target_platform below, so trellis_allocator._capability_gate compares sm_121 against the E2M1/E4M3 SM floors instead of returning legal without comparing anything.
